mapper.select: SELECT su.ID, su.TENANT_ID, su.NAME FROM SYS_RELATION sr JOIN SYS_USER su ON sr.OBJECT_ID = su.ID WHERE sr.TARGET_ID = '${targetId}' AND sr.CATEGORY = 'SYS_USER_HAS_ROLE' AND su.DELETE_FLAG = 'NOT_DELETE' AND su.USER_STATUS = 'ENABLE'
SELECT su.* FROM SYS_RELATION sr JOIN SYS_RESOURCE su ON sr.TARGET_ID = su.ID AND sr.OBJECT_ID = '${objectId}' AND sr.CATEGORY = 'SYS_ROLE_HAS_RESOURCE' AND su.DELETE_FLAG = 'NOT_DELETE' LIMIT 10
